headline: Nutrien Q3 Earnings Slide 39% on Lower Nitrogen Sales and Higher Costs
summary: Nutrien reported a 39% decline in third-quarter earnings, missing analyst forecasts as sales in its nitrogen division fell and operational costs increased.
why: Fertilizer producers are subject to cyclical agricultural commodity pricing, input cost inflation, and seasonal demand fluctuations.

impacts.name: Nutrien Ltd.
impacts.why: Lower quarterly sales and rising costs directly reduce net earnings for fertilizer producers.
